name: 96712 · Haleiwa, HI
findings: ZIP 96712 (Haleiwa) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96712 (Haleiwa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
73% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
